description: This file contains a runtime validator for a Supabase Storage bucket, specifically to verify its existence and accessibility within a React frontend project. It includes functions to extract project reference info, perform upload probes, and validate storage bucket permissions and existence.

methods.name: getProjectRef()
methods.description: Extracts the project reference from the REACT_APP_SUPABASE_URL environment variable for diagnostic purposes.

methods.name: probeUpload(bucketSlug)
methods.description: Attempts to upload a tiny blob to the specified bucket to help classify whether the error is due to a missing bucket or permission issues.

methods.name: validateBucket(bucketSlug = AUCTION_IMAGES_BUCKET)
methods.description: Main exported function that verifies the existence and permissions of a specified Supabase Storage bucket, performing listing and upload probes as needed.
